summary.text: Day Hochman-Vigil, listed by Ballotpedia as Dayan Hochman-Vigil, is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 15 who took office on January 1, 2019, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Hochman-Vigil succeeded Sarah Maestas Barnes (R) in the District 15 seat.
In the 2025-2026 session, Hochman-Vigil serves on the Transportation, Public Works & Capital Improvements Committee, the House Judiciary Committee and the Rules and Order of Business Committee.
Hochman-Vigil chaired the Transportation, Public Works & Capital Improvements Committee in 2023-2024.
